topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: Walking past the old playground, I noticed the space where my childhood tree once stood is now an empty patch of grass. The tree, a sapling when I was young, had been a quiet witness to seasons and secrets, its branches reaching out like arms. Now, it’s just a memory. I trace the outline in my mind where the trunk used to be, recalling the way the leaves whispered in the breeze. It’s strange how a part of me feels lighter, even as I stand here, where the ground is cooler for lack of shade. Life moves on, and so do we, leaving marks that fade with time.
